note: Every figure is what the page named in its source showed on the day it was read (UTC), through the web fetch of this session. null means the page did not state it; "unlimited" is the page's own word; a price that did not render is recorded as such and never estimated. Prices are US dollars. yearlyUsd is the yearly total where the page states one; perMonthBilledYearlyUsd is the per-month figure a page prints beside "billed annually". feeOnSalePct is the fee the page names for a sale on that plan (feeIncludesProcessing says whether the page folds card processing into it). Nothing is estimated; secondary sources are marked as such. The demand evidence block records the figures the demand model is calibrated on, each with its source and date; where a page refused the fetch, the figure is what the search result's own text showed, and that is said.
